canDoYue: 你識叫單、分單、用卡機，仲識講貼士。
canDoEn: Ask for the bill, split it, pay by card, and talk about the tip.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we have the bill now, and shall we split it or pay together tonight?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以而家埋單，今晚分單定係一齊付？
dialogue.say: Could we have the bill now, and shall we split it or pay together tonight?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: We can split it into two separate checks, or you can pay together on one bill.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以分開兩張單，或者你哋一張單一齊付。
dialogue.say: We can split it into two separate checks, or you can pay together on one bill.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please bring the card machine here, and I will pay this check by card.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔該攞卡機過嚟呢度，我會用卡付呢張單。
dialogue.say: Please bring the card machine here, and I will pay this check by card.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: The card machine is here now, and your receipt will include the service charge.
dialogue.glossYue: 卡機而家喺度，收據會包括服務費。
dialogue.say: The card machine is here now, and your receipt will include the service charge.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The service was kind tonight, so I will add a tip and you can keep the change.
dialogue.glossYue: 今晚服務好好，我會加貼士，零錢你留低就得。
dialogue.say: The service was kind tonight, so I will add a tip and you can keep the change.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Thank you, and the total does include the service charge before that tip tonight.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝，今晚貼士之前個總數已經包括服務費。
dialogue.say: Thank you, and the total does include the service charge before that tip tonight.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we also get the cake as a takeaway before we leave the restaurant tonight?
dialogue.glossYue: 今晚走之前可唔可以將蛋糕打包外賣？
dialogue.say: Could we also get the cake as a takeaway before we leave the restaurant tonight?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Here is your takeaway box now, and thank you again for coming in tonight.
dialogue.glossYue: 外賣盒而家喺度，多謝你哋今晚嚟。
dialogue.say: Here is your takeaway box now, and thank you again for coming in tonight.

When a guest says service charge, what does that phrase mean on the restaurant bill?
quiz.explain: service charge 係服務費，唔係貼士。

quiz.prompt: When a guest says keep the change, what should you do with the coins?
Which of these bill words contains the /l/ sound: include, tip, or check?
quiz.explain: include 有 /l/。tip 同 check 冇。

sound.title: 包括入面嗰個音
sound.note: include 有 /l/。tip 開頭係 /t/。check 開頭係 /tʃ/。服務費同貼士唔好撈亂。
